d:
Jharkhand ki kanun-vyavastha par Babulal Marandi ka ne uthae saval, puchha kahan surakshit hain log?
Jharkhand men kanun-vyavastha ko lekar ek bar phir siyasat tej ho gaee hai. babulal marandi ne rajy ki kanun-vyavastha par saval uthate hue hemant soren sarkar ko ghera hai, unhonne saval kiya ki aakhir jharkhand men aam log kahan surakshit hain? dekhie babulal marandi ne aur kya kaha.
